description:
Repair the broken intra-doc links in the `gf2-kernels-hip` crate documentation.

## Background

`gf2-kernels-hip` sits outside the default Cargo workspace, so the workspace documentation build and the intra-doc link repair in `2d65e37f` do not reach it. `cargo doc --manifest-path crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml` reports unresolved links, among them `arch`, `HipStream`, `rand_chacha::ChaCha20Rng` and `gf2_coding::modem::FastGrayQamDemapper`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cargo doc --manifest-path crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml --no-deps` on Rust 1.95 reports no unresolved, private-target or redundant intra-doc link diagnostics on a host where the crate builds.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each repaired link resolves to the item the surrounding prose names, or the link markup is removed where no such item exists.
title: Repair broken intra-doc links in gf2-kernels-hip
